name: TNF receptor associated factor 7

function.text: TRAF7 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRAF7. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in apoptotic process and protein ubiquitination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); cardiac, facial, and digital anomalies with developmental delay (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Pleural Mesothelioma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

function.text: TRAF7 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRAF7. Based in part on similarity, it is an E3 ubiquitin and SUMO-protein ligase that plays a role in different biological processes such as innate immunity, inflammation or apoptosis. It potentiates MAP3K3-mediated activation of JUN/AP1 and DDIT3 transcriptional regulators. It negatively regulates MYB transcriptional activity by sequestering it to the cytosol via SUMOylation.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); cardiac, facial, and digital anomalies with developmental delay (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRAF7 have been reported in pleural mesothelioma.
